Excuse me, have you changed the menus here?
I notice there's a symbol next to some of the names of the dishes.
What does it mean?
Oh, all the food with this green V symbol is cooked without meat.
Some customers ask which meals are vegetarian, so this is an easy way for them to know.
That makes sense.
A lot of people are trying to eat healthier now.
Oh, yes.
If you look on the back of the menu, we've even added nutritional information about the food selections.
Customers like these features so much that last month we were voted best restaurant in the area.

现在很多人都在尝试吃得更健康。
哦，是的。
如果你看菜单背面，我们甚至添加了关于这些菜品的营养信息。
顾客非常喜欢这些功能，以至于上个月我们被评为该地区最佳餐厅。
